title: Time-Dependent Low-Energy Simulation Accelerates Adiabatic State Preparation
summary: Hamiltonian simulations are key subroutines in adiabatic quantum computation and quantum many-body physics, where quantum dynamics often happen in the low-energy sector. Previous studies have shown that the low-energy assumption can reduce the resource requirements of standard time-independent Hamiltonian simulation algorithms. However, whether such advantages extend to time-dependent Hamiltonian simulation remains open.
